summary: {person} sends a depositor to the state office that can authorize the bank to reopen.
realLife: Roosevelt explained that state authorities licensed state banks outside the Federal Reserve membership and that Treasury sought a common timetable.
gates: A resident asks which authority can reopen a bank.
weights: Different charter types operate in the same town.
inGame: needs: the bank charter and responsible licensing authority.

turns.pulledBy: The charter places it under federal review.
turns.writesBack: The inquiry goes to the federal examiner.

turns.what: The state approves a later date.
turns.pulledBy: Its examination finishes after the federal opening round.
turns.writesBack: The state notice gives its own date.
